import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"], DATABASES={})
django.setup()
from django.db.models import FileField
from django.core.files.storage import FileSystemStorage

def get_storage():
    return FileSystemStorage()

f = FileField(storage=get_storage)
name, path, args, kwargs = f.deconstruct()
print("deconstructed storage is the callable:", kwargs["storage"] is get_storage)
print("field.storage still evaluated instance:", isinstance(f.storage, FileSystemStorage))
# round-trip: reconstructing from deconstructed kwargs keeps the callable
f2 = FileField(*args, **kwargs)
n2, p2, a2, kw2 = f2.deconstruct()
print("round-trip stable:", kw2["storage"] is get_storage)
# non-callable storage still deconstructs to the instance
inst = FileSystemStorage()
f3 = FileField(storage=inst)
print("plain instance deconstructs to itself:", f3.deconstruct()[3]["storage"] is inst)
# default storage omitted
print("default storage omitted:", "storage" not in FileField().deconstruct()[3])
EOF
